cases.name: Wendi Rose Davidson
cases.about: Josh Davidson said he'll never forget his mother’s kind-hearted nature & willingness to give everyone the benefit of the doubt, which is what she did when her fiance’s past came to light. “I did have serious concern,” he said. “My mom and the rest of the family knew about his past. But there was paperwork that showed he got off. My mother chose to think that he could have just been someone who got the tough end of the deal; that he changed.” The relationship was out of the norm for Wendi Davidson. “She had never dated anyone who had legal troubles,” Josh Davidson said. “I was shocked she was with someone like that.” He reiterated his mother always chose to see the good in people.
cases.narrative: Her body was discovered in her basement.

cases.name: Linda Hachey Robinson
cases.about:
Intensely private and reserved, Linda Robinson was also diligent, exacting and detail oriented, her former boss recalled.

“That’s an enormous thing to have in a finance director in a complicated business,” said Mark DiSalvo, president and CEO of Sema4, Inc., also known as Semaphore, in North Andover.

Robinson was his director of finance for 25 years. 

She was born in Lynn, MA and attended Lynn Public Schools and graduated from Merrimack College in North Andover with a degree in accounting, DiSalvo said.

She moved to the Merrimack Valley during her first marriage to a man from Methuen named Sean Quinn. He said they originally purchased the land and built the home at 48 Porter Road.

Linda was very proud of her Canadian heritage and shared a close relationship with her mother, who died in 2020, DiSalvo said.

Her looks were stunning and she had been a model at one point, he said.

Private and protective of her family, he said she had no social media presence.
